text:
Anna Ng: heads up — Console preflight is showing a red ERROR pill for routing configs that only have lint-level advisories. users keep thinking their save failed. :grimacing:
Mike Levine: can repro locally. it flips the overall status to ERROR if any rule is present in the lint output, even when rule severity = advisory. bad UX.
Devon Patel: that's because we fold schema validation + linter output into one boolean `is_preflight_ok`. we don't separate blocking vs advisory. think we should.
Tara Chen: strong +1. Schema errors (missing required fields, invalid types) should be blocking. Heuristic linting (header ordering, tie-break hints) should be advisory and shown as suggestions. :thumbsup:
Mike Levine: quick snippet of what we're seeing in the linter output: 
```
- path: rules[3].match.headers
  rule: header-tiebreaker-order
  severity: advisory
  message: 'Header order may impact priority resolution; consider anchored matchers'
```
Anna Ng: exactly. Console shows the red pill, and the save modal still allows save which confuses people (red but savable).
PreflightBot: Preflight check completed: 1 error, 3 warnings, 2 advisories (see details)
Devon Patel: proposal: split UI status into two parts — a blocking status (red/orange) driven only by schema errors + explicit lint rules marked `block: true` in our config, and a separate advisory panel with actionable suggestions and autofix links.
Tara Chen: for rollout UX, we should add a small toggle: "Treat advisories as errors during save" that workspace admins can flip. default false. helps teams who want stricter checks.
Mike Levine: implementation notes: gating points — preflight API needs to return structured output: { schema_errors: [], blockers: [], advisories: [] } instead of a flat list. Console then computes summary badges. This also makes it easy for the CLI to `--strict` flag.
Anna Ng: makes sense. We also need to update linter configs so maintainers can mark certain rules as `block: true` per org. Otherwise teams can't opt-in.
Jen Ortiz: I'll file the umbrella issue for design + API + linter config changes. tagging @Mike Levine for the API and @Tara Chen for product requirements. :ballot_box_with_check:
Devon Patel: another edge case — we have a rule that suggests collapsing duplicate header transforms. it's advisory, but when run through autofix it changes behavior subtly in some internal tests. need to mark autofix as opt-in.
Tara Chen: UX for details panel: show counts by category, each item one-liner with quick-fix or explain why it's advisory. include link to docs and `View in Playground` for a dry-run.
Mike Levine: dev plan: (1) change preflight service to emit categorized output (2) expose `treat_advisories_as_errors` flag in workspace settings (3) Console: badge + advisory panel + save modal behavior, (4) update linter rule metadata and add tests.
Anna Ng: can we add a small e2e in console tests that asserts save button state matches blocker count? I can add that.
PreflightBot: New preflight schema version 2026-03 released. See /docs/preflight-changelog
Jen Ortiz: filing now and will attach initial design comps. assigning to Mike, Devon, Anna. ETA for API change?
Mike Levine: aiming to spec and PR in the next 2 sprints. will post API contract here when ready.
Anna Ng: thanks — small follow-up: example YAML that triggered the advisory (so we can include in tests):
```yaml
rules:
  - id: route-x
    match:
      path: /search
      headers:
        - name: x-priority
          type: anchored
        - name: x-priority
          type: prefix
    transforms:
      - remove: X-Debug
```
Devon Patel: nice. I'll add a unit test that ensures advisory rules don't block save unless workspace flag enabled.
Tara Chen: cool — this should improve onboarding. also prevents false P1 support tickets. :sweat_smile:
Mike Levine: will keep thread updated. thanks all.
Jen Ortiz: noted, closing task creation — will link design ticket here when done.
